fields.description:
According to specification, calling Repository.login(Credentials, String) with a non-existent wokspaceName should return NoSuchWorkspaceException.

In fact it returns RepositoryException.
fields.summary: Wrong exeption returned from Repository.login(Credentials, String)
fields.environment: JRE 1.5.0_10, JBoss 4.0.5 GA, JBossWS 1.0.4 GA, WinXP SP2

comments.body:
Here's my code:

try {
  m_session = repository.login(credentials, "foo");
} catch (NoSuchWorkspaceException e) {
  System.out.println("No such workspace");
} catch (RepositoryException e) {
  System.out.println("Repository exception");
}
